title: 第15章弟子也是很气很气一时没有忍住第16章 你心怀不轨断送宗门前途
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
墨尘居愣了。
王飞宇脸上的笑容也瞬间僵住。
何念慈和吴长风两位三品炼丹师也是瞬间目瞪口呆。
而一侧近万青玄宗弟子，表情更是全部直接石化。
其中不乏看好戏的几千位弟子，脸色也瞬间沉了下来。
所有人都惊了，仿佛被九天神雷劈中后脑，呆若木鸡。
陆成的字字句句，不断回荡在所有人的脑海中！
前半句让不少人看向陆成的眼神充满了鄙夷，这舔功口才让不少人都暗自摇头，甚至方才言辞犀利，意气风发的王飞宇，在陆成面前都要低了半分。
如此发自肺腑的违心之语，真不愧是来自杂役峰，他们扪心自问，断不会说出如此让人脸红的话来。
但陆成“他们的天赋太差了，入不了您的慧眼”这句话的后半句，却如潮水般不断强行灌入他们的脑海！
所有人目光全部从王飞宇的身上移开，再次聚集到陆成的身上，双目中纷纷露出不可置信的眼神。
疯了吧这是！
你一个杂役弟子，说这句话就有点过分了吧！
你夸你的墨尘居严师出高徒，这没有错。
但你说我们天赋差，入不了墨尘居的慧眼，是什么意思？！
难道你一个杂役弟子，你自认为你的天赋，要比在场的所有人都要高？
你成为了墨尘居的弟子，就目中无人，看不起所有人？
这也太狂了吧？
这时，何念慈和吴长风身后的王飞宇，脸色瞬间变得极为精彩起来。
他死死压制着嘴角，差点忍不住要仰天狂笑！

他看向陆成的眼神，充满了可怜，他想到陆成竟然这般没脑子，简直可笑至极！
陆成说他也就罢了，竟还口出狂言道是他们的天赋太差了。
反过来说，意思就是在场同门不配成为墨尘居的弟子，是他们天赋太差，而陆成炼丹天赋惊人，力压所有人，配得上墨尘居的慧眼！
这简单的一句话，无疑把所有人全部都得罪了！
你特么也太自大了，你什么身份啊，哪怕你此刻是墨尘居的弟子，如此人神共愤的一句话，无疑激怒了所有人，哪怕墨尘居想保，恐怕都保不住了！
毕竟这数万同门师兄，可是有很多人，都是内门长老的亲传弟子！
墨尘居再强，再护犊子，他也不可能保下陆成！
王飞宇仿佛已经能看到陆成接下来的一万种死法了！
这时，何念慈身后的一位白衣二品炼丹师突然走出，他脸色阴沉地盯着陆成，寒声道：“陆成，你这话就有点太狂了吧？我们炼丹天赋差？特么老子用脚都比你炼得好！”
吴长风身后也走出一位二品炼丹师，嗤笑道：“我见过狂人，从未见过你这般目中无人的废物，老子今天倒要看看，你今天要是炼不出极品夺灵丹，那就不要走出丹峰了！”
“以阴谋诡计欺骗墨大师也就算了，哪来的脸来这认证一品炼丹师，恐怕定是又用某种阴谋诡计骗过三位长老，来试图领取一品炼丹师的供奉吧？！”
“哼……怪不得青玄宗建立五百年，杂役峰没有一位杂役弟子筑基，原来是有原因的，往日里舔人舔惯了，今日竟然出了这么一个口出狂言的宵小之辈！”
“特么的，一个杂役弟子也敢这么嚣张，简直是反了天了，宗主都不敢说这个话，他怎么敢的！”
“艹！我今天倒是要看看他是怎么炼丹的！”
content_en:
Mo Chenju was stunned.
The smile on Wang Feiyu's face froze instantly.
The two third-level alchemists, He Nianci and Wu Changfeng, were also stunned for a moment.
On one side, the expressions of the nearly Wanqing Xuanzong disciples all turned to stone.
Among them were thousands of disciples who were watching the show, and their expressions instantly darkened.
Everyone was shocked, as if they had been hit in the back of the head by the Nine Heavens Divine Thunder, and were stunned.
Lu Cheng's words kept echoing in everyone's minds!
The first half of the sentence made many people look at Lu Cheng with contempt. His eloquence made many people shake their heads secretly. Even Wang Feiyu, who had just spoken sharply and was high-spirited, felt half inferior in front of Lu Cheng.
Such heartfelt words that go against one's will are truly worthy of coming from the Handler Peak. They asked themselves, they would never say such shameful words.
But the second half of Lu Cheng's sentence, "Their talents are too poor to catch your eye," was forced into their minds like a tide!
Everyone's eyes moved away from Wang Feiyu and focused on Lu Cheng again, with disbelief in their eyes.
This is crazy!
For a handyman disciple like you, this is a bit too much to say!
You are right in praising your master Mo Chen Juyan for producing a great disciple.
But what do you mean when you say that we are not talented enough to meet Mo Chenju’s discerning eye? !
Do you, a handyman disciple, think that your talent is higher than everyone present?
Since you became Mo Chenju's disciple, you are arrogant and look down on everyone?
Isn't this too crazy?
At this time, Wang Feiyu's expression behind He Nianci and Wu Changfeng suddenly became extremely exciting.
He suppressed the corners of his mouth so hard that he almost couldn't help but look up to the sky and laugh wildly!
The look he looked at Lu Cheng was full of pity. It was ridiculous to think that Lu Cheng was so brainless!
Lu Cheng said that was all he wanted, but he even said arrogantly that their talents were too poor.
On the other hand, it means that the same disciples here are not worthy of becoming Mo Chenju's disciples because they have poor talents. However, Lu Cheng's talent in alchemy is amazing, surpassing everyone else, and he is worthy of Mo Chenju's insight!
This simple sentence undoubtedly offended everyone!
You are so arrogant. What is your identity? Even if you are Mo Chenju's disciple at the moment, such words that are outraged by both humans and gods will undoubtedly anger everyone. Even if Mo Chenju wants to protect him, he may not be able to!
After all, there are tens of thousands of fellow disciples, but many of them are direct disciples of the inner sect elders!
No matter how strong Mo Chenju was, no matter how protective he was, there was no way he could protect Lu Cheng!
Wang Feiyu seemed to be able to see the next 10,000 ways Lu Cheng would die!
At this time, a second-grade alchemist in white clothes suddenly walked out behind He Nianci. He stared at Lu Cheng with a gloomy face and said in a cold voice: "Lu Cheng, are you a little too crazy to say this? We are not talented in alchemy? I can do it better with my feet than you!"
A second-grade alchemist also walked out from behind Wu Changfeng, and sneered: "I have seen madmen, but I have never seen such an arrogant waste like you. I want to see it today. If you can't refine the best spirit-seizing pill today, then don't leave the pill peak!"
"It's okay to deceive Master Mo with conspiracy and tricks. Who has the nerve to come here to be certified as a first-grade alchemist? I'm afraid he must have used some kind of conspiracy to deceive the three elders and try to receive the tribute of a first-grade alchemist?!"
"Hmph... No wonder Qingxuan Sect has been established for five hundred years. There is not a single servant disciple building a foundation in the servant peak. It turns out there is a reason. I used to lick people in the past, but today there is such a young man who talks arrogantly!"
"What the hell, a handyman disciple dares to be so arrogant. It's so outrageous. Even the sect master doesn't dare to say this. How dare he!"
"Fuck! I want to see how he makes pills today!"
